name: AlternatingChain
summary: Record 5's Decode-8 on the chain n32sp, whose user levels alternate one ~27.85-bit prime and two ~26.15-bit primes (scales 2^36 / 2^44.15, the HPS-exact ModDown there; every prime below 2^28, the bootstrap levels' primes kept), with record 5's configs and recipe replanned on it: 99 refreshes per token instead of 112; position 8's patch no longer applied before its token; CutMax slightly less precise (disclosed); Prefill-128 unchanged.

ckks.chain: Decode-8: n32sp, n32a4 with its 9 user pairs replaced by 6 single ~27.85-bit primes alternating with 6 pairs of ~2 x 26.15 bits; 51 Q + 13 special primes, every prime < 2^28, dnum 4, log QP 1728.55. Prefill-128: n32a4, unchanged, log QP 1733.26. log_qp above is the larger; the client bounds every dense-secret key at 1734 bits
ckks.special_primes: Decode-8 (n32sp): record 3's 9 and 142344193, 107216897, 106037249, 104857601 (dense keys only); Prefill-128 (n32a4): record 5's
